greenfield-design-sync.meetingContext: One of an ongoing series of meetings (scheduled daily) designing a brand-new product from scratch: a) we plan, scope, and critique the product before it exists, b) we align conceptually on approach and process for working together, c) we discuss frameworks and reference concepts that will help us lead our agentic coders in similar fashion. The standing agenda is progress on open design questions. Tangents about scheduling, vendor admin, and personal chat are common in this series and are not what these meetings are for.
